quarterly_data.quarter: Lenovo press release: Lenovo Unveils First Laptop Manufactured in Saudi Arabia, (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lenovo unveiled the first laptop produced at its manufacturing facility in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (built under its strategic collaboration with ALAT), with mass production of limited products commencing in late 2026. Lenovo says the Riyadh facility is the first globally to produce its full portfolio of products, including PCs, desktops, Motorola smartphones and servers, and that it expands a production footprint of more than 30 sites in 11 countries. Tareq Alangari (President, Lenovo Middle East, Turkiye and Africa): Saudi Arabia 'will play an increasingly important role in Lenovo's global manufacturing, innovation, and supply chain network'.
quarterly_data.figure: mass production of limited products from late 2026; more than 30 sites in 11 countries
